Prerequisites: Instinctive Hunter beastmaster trick

A beastmaster with this trick has a vendetta to take down any creature he tracks. When acting in the surprise round against a tracked creature, the beastmaster may take a move action, standard action, and swift action (not a full-round action), not just a move or standard action (plus a swift action). If the beastmaster can already take a standard and a move action during the surprise round, they can instead make a full-round action.
